root_cause.text: `ext4_mb_release()` conditionally flushes the pending `s_discard_work` only when the `DISCARD` mount option is enabled, which fails to drain queued discard work during unmount if the filesystem was remounted with `nodiscard`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff removes the `if (test_opt(sb, DISCARD))` check in `ext4_mb_release()`, ensuring `flush_work(&sbi->s_discard_work)` is always executed regardless of the current mount options.

    ext4: get discard out of jbd2 commit kthread contex
    
    Right now, discard is issued and waited to be completed in jbd2
    commit kthread context after the logs are committed. When large

    kthread can be blocked for long time. Then all of the metadata
    operations can be blocked
bic_trace_step.reason: This commit introduces the vulnerability. In `ext4_mb_release()`, the code conditionally flushes `s_discard_work` only if `test_opt(sb, DISCARD)` is true (lines 3529-3536). If the filesystem is remounted with 'nodiscard', this check will evaluate to false, and any pending discard work will not be flushed/drained during unmount, leading to a use-after-free or memory leak.
